profiles.role_summary: Investor-owned electric and gas utility serving much of Greater Boston, including Dorchester.
profiles.resident_relevance: Residents contact Eversource for power outages, electric/gas service, and meter issues.

profiles.role_summary: City water and sewer utility responsible for drinking water distribution and wastewater collection in Boston.
profiles.resident_relevance: Residents use BWSC for water/sewer billing, leaks, and service disruptions.

profiles.role_summary: Regional public transit agency operating buses, subway, ferry, and commuter rail serving Boston neighborhoods.
profiles.resident_relevance: Dorchester residents rely on MBTA buses and Red Line / Fairmount service for daily travel.

profiles.role_summary: Municipal police department that publishes incident report open data used for neighborhood safety context.
profiles.resident_relevance: BPD open data informs public-safety questions; emergencies still require 911.

profiles.role_summary: Municipal fire and emergency response department for the City of Boston.
profiles.resident_relevance: Handles fires, rescue, and related emergencies; call 911 for immediate danger.

profiles.role_summary: City non-emergency service request system for street, sanitation, housing, and related issues.
profiles.resident_relevance: Residents use Boston 311 to report and track non-emergency neighborhood service requests.

profiles.role_summary: Statewide energy-efficiency program offering rebates, assessments, and weatherization support.
profiles.resident_relevance: Helps renters and homeowners reduce energy costs through efficiency upgrades.

profiles.role_summary: Community development corporation focused on housing, economic opportunity, and neighborhood stability in Codman Square.
profiles.resident_relevance: Local partner for housing and community development issues in Dorchester's Codman Square area.

profiles.role_summary: City planning and development agency involved in zoning, planning review, and major development processes.
profiles.resident_relevance: Relevant for zoning, planning proposals, and development review questions.

profiles.role_summary: City department that handles building, housing, and related code inspection and permitting functions.
profiles.resident_relevance: Residents encounter ISD for permits, housing code issues, and building inspections.
